events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` and `projects.html` have `<html>` with no `lang`, the same "Project Matrix" title, no `<h1>` and no links between pages (`issues.html` has nav). Their `fetch(...).then(r => r.json())` has no `.ok` check or catch, and the committed fallback `www_project_repos.json` is `[]`, so `Math.min(...[])` gives Infinity and the page shows a blank table with no explanation. `issues.html` already handles these cases.

## What to do

1. Add `lang="en"`, a distinct `<title>` and `<h1>` per page, and the nav from `issues.html`.
2. Wrap the loads in try/catch with an `.ok` check and show an error row; show a "no data yet" message for an empty array.

> **Note:** Cells are now escaped (b5b0d592be); keep using those helpers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All three pages have lang and cross-links
- [ ] HTTP errors show a message
- [ ] Empty JSON shows an empty-state message

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-owasp-projects/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-projects
```
